name: MS Fantasy Style Flux.2 klein
description: This LoRA helps create fantasy-style images. During the LoRA training, I focused not only on the fantasy style but also on detail and contrast. This gives LoRA a unique touch even to images not created in a fantasy style (e.g., landscapes). Details are rendered more sharply, and contrast and color intensity are enhanced. A trigger is not required. LoRA operates at a weight between 0.6 and 2.0. With characters, a higher weight shifts the style towards semi-realism.
